description: Get the DevicErts record of one device by slug. summary (default): names, manufacturer, status, risk class with its legal system, and every authorization or listing with number, dates and status. detail=full adds identifiers (UDI-DI, Basic UDI-DI, catalogue numbers), FDA product codes, EMDN/GMDN codes, EU certificates, FDA recalls, EU market availability and registry properties. Old slugs resolve to the current one. Use when the slug is known and the device's facts are needed. Prefer this over `fetch`. Do not use to find a device (use search_devices or find_device_by_identifier) or when only recalls or only certificates are needed (use get_device_recalls or get_device_certificates, smaller answers). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

detail.description: summary (default): names, manufacturer, status, class, authorizations. full: adds identifiers, nomenclature codes, EU certificates, FDA recalls, EU market availability and registry properties.

slug.description: Device slug: the last part of its https://devicerts.com/devices/<slug> URL, as returned by search_devices or find_device_by_identifier. A full page URL or a device:<slug> id is accepted. e.g. heartstart-frx-defibrillator-p180028

name: get_device
title: Get a device record
